purpose: Files that still start captured subprocesses whose failure keeps no reason. This is a ratchet: a file may only shrink or leave, and a file absent from this list may not appear with a violation. Clearing an entry means converting its call sites to carry stderr into the raised error. An empty list is the goal, not an omission.
why: A captured subprocess that fails reports only an exit status. In this repository that cost six release runs of guessing before the real cause appeared. See docs/maintainer/observation-integrity.md.
